about: One entry per gap ID of the map's Gaps summary lists: how it is closed, and for an API gap the requests and JSON paths that show it closed. Checked by tests/test_api_web_map_gaps.py; run against a siteapi with `siteapi bench --gaps` (api/README.md).

"Live" hard-coded in the dock, `IndexHero` window and Overview hero; no page polls `/v1/version`: Website change: show data age from `generatedAt` and poll `/v1/version` (304 when unchanged), refetching on a new `revision`; extends HOME-1 to every page.

JSON-LD `dateModified` from three export dates; none on `/networks` and the network page: Website change: one `generatedAt` per build from any answer the page fetches; add it to the two network pages.
`SHOW_DEMO` demo networks and re-numbered ranks on every page: Website change: delete the switch and demo branches with the API switch-over; ranks from RK `rank`, `peers`.

Hard-coded `INDEX_NETWORK_SLUGS` for redirects, footer, sitemaps, llms.txt: Website change: build the slug table and the footer's provider lists from `/v1/networks` at build time; link only listed slugs; keep the `smartproxy` alias.
`NetworkStrip` crashes on 0 networks (server render): Website guards the empty list (hide the strip or an empty-state line); no API change.

`category` (and catalog `difficulty`) of the browser targets without a `site.targets` row: Catalog rows (owner content), written with SQL as `api/scripts/*.sql`; W4 defaults the difficulty to the scoring weight meanwhile.

Target scores rank every product group of a window together, not per proxy kind: All 18 networks are residential today, so the ranks are the residential ones; per-kind ranking waits until a second kind is measured.
Data strings (`label`, `category`, `passCondition`) used as translation keys on the targets page: Website keys target copy by `targets[].id`; the API keeps serving English catalog wording.

Hard-coded "Eight"/"eight" and "ticketing queue" in the targets page's window title, meta and JSON-LD description and keywords: Website copy built from the card count (TGT-9 field once W4/W7 serve it), ticketing mention removed.

Targets page still built on the mock suite (`ticketing_queue`, no `ai_answers`, no group filter, no sources breakdown): Website change when it switches to the API; reads `targets[].group`, `.source`, `.difficulty` and `sources[]` (W4 adds `sources` to its cells).
"Download the dataset" serves the website's `home.json`: The website route redirects to `/v1/dataset` (already immutable and precompressed).

NET-BUCKET-TEXT (network page row 131) was withdrawn: the stored facts and the 24h series are 5-minute buckets (atlas `calculated/aggregate.py` `coverage_basis`, `series`); the 30-minute value is the every-request scoring slot.
Stored weekly analyses beyond 30 days: No source yet; out of scope until analyses are written.

By-target best mark can compare a Chrome rate with a Camoufox rate (C61, C63): Website marks the best only among cells of the same `engine`, or reads one engine's body (`/v1/targets?engine=<e>`); W4 carries `engine`, `otherEngines` and the per-engine bodies (#735).
Success rate hint misdescribes the figure (C33): Website copy: "Mean of time-slot success rates, browser targets excluded" (as HOME-42).
